_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 4-5 November 2025: Japan reserves, Venezuela, and the New York grid.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a woman with short hair whom he does not recognise, and is told by someone in the room that she is the prime minister of Japan, confirming that is her.
mentions.quote: I see a woman that has short hair. That is her
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an identification supplied to him in the room. Takaichi had taken office on 21 October 2025, two weeks earlier.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a tilled field with plants growing up out of the plowed dirt, and flags it explicitly as a vision.
mentions.quote: That field has been tilled, but the plants are growing up
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim on its own: the opening image of the sequence that follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says a stalk like corn comes up out of the tilled ground with a coin at the top of it.
mentions.quote: at the top of it is a coin
mentions.falsify_match: A digital asset growing into a national reserve holding.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The image is interpreted in the next passage rather than here.

mentions.claim_text: He interprets it as a future reserve, comparing it to a gold standard backing America, and says Japan will hold this as its standard.
mentions.quote: A reserve. A future reserve
mentions.falsify_match: Japan holding a crypto or digital asset as a national reserve.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. A named country and a named function, which makes it checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says he hears the word standard, that this will also happen with another country in South America, and asks who the man is who just won.
mentions.quote: this will be with another country in South America
mentions.falsify_match: A South American country adopting a digital reserve standard.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. He asks for the name rather than giving it.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will be pronounced soon, that the South American country will be like this, and that he sees two.
mentions.quote: this will be pronounced soon
mentions.falsify_match: Two countries announcing such a standard.
mentions.falsify_miss: None do. Soon carries no date.

mentions.claim_text: He says alliances strengthen daily and there is an attempt at overthrowing the government of Venezuela.
mentions.quote: an overthrowing of the government concerning Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: Regime change in Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the word oil many times with Monday, says natural resources, then says to watch Iraq, and that three men at the Central Bank are still standing in the way.
mentions.quote: three men still standing in the way. The three men at the Central Bank
mentions.falsify_match: Three named figures at the Central Bank of Iraq blocking a currency move.
mentions.falsify_miss: None identified. The count of three is the checkable part; the Monday has no date attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says the same thing falls over Venezuela as a type and shadow: corruption in the government and in the finances, keeping the people broke and oppressed.
mentions.quote: Corruption in the government. Corruption in the finances
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a description of conditions in Venezuela that have been continuously true and widely reported.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees palm trees and a Rolls-Royce, like the way the Saudi men are.
mentions.quote: I SEE PALM TREES. Rolls-Royce
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: uninterpreted imagery of wealth.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He declares a breakthrough coming repeatedly and calls for the arteries to be unclogged.
mentions.quote: We call all the arteries to be unclogged
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a declaration with no subject or measure.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is in Europe again and sees Tomahawk missiles and the red-tipped missiles again.
mentions.quote: I see those Tomahawk missiles, those red tip missiles
mentions.falsify_match: Tomahawk missiles supplied to Ukraine and used against Russia.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not. Tomahawk transfer to Ukraine was under public discussion when this was given.

mentions.claim_text: He says to go back to New York harbour, that it went from Ukraine to New York harbour to that bomb, and that he sees the building.
mentions.quote: From Ukraine to New York harbor. It went from there to that bomb
mentions.falsify_match: A device reaching New York harbour by a route traceable to Ukraine.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The route and the destination are named, which is unusually specific.

mentions.claim_text: He says he will find the building he saw in New York, that he has an idea whose it is, and that he will look for it in a web search.
mentions.quote: I am going to find that building that I saw in New York
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an intention to identify the building afterwards by searching for it.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim. Recorded because identifying a vision by search after the fact is the method the corpus should be able to show.

mentions.claim_text: He notes seven thousand watching, and prays that the Japanese leader make smart decisions for her country over the reserve, and mentions South Korea.
mentions.quote: we pray for Japan reserve with the fruit
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition. The live count of seven thousand is a measurable figure for the audience size.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Asian community becomes a major powerhouse in the crypto world for the new industrial revolution with reserves, and that the Lord shows him South Korea and Japan and calls them the Sooners.
mentions.quote: he calls them the Sooners
mentions.falsify_match: South Korea and Japan leading on crypto reserves. Both legislated on 15 July 2026, ahead of the United States.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. This is a restatement of the June 2025 Sooners word, eight months before the outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says Venezuela is very communist and its people live under a terrible government like Cuba, and that he saw America trying to bring about a regime change there.
mentions.quote: I saw America trying to have a regime change in Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: American action to change the government of Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Given while US strikes on alleged drug boats off Venezuela were already the running story.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something three or four feet thick resting on the whole nation of Venezuela, which looked jungly and tropical though he has never been there.
mentions.quote: it was resting on all of the nation
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a spiritual covering over a country with no observable measure.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are not brothers but that is how the spirit is, then describes seeing a bank of Iraq and the Lord speaking about bringing liberty and finances to the people of Iraq.
mentions.quote: I saw a bank of Iraq and the Lord was talking about bringing in liberty
mentions.falsify_match: A change at the Central Bank of Iraq that improves ordinary finances there.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The dinar material recurs across the corpus without a date.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions Saudi Arabia and other nations, says he finds it interesting what the Lord showed him, and admits he does not know how it will happen but knows he sees it.
mentions.quote: I do not know. I just know that I see it
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: he states he has no mechanism.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something hanging above New York City and the eastern United States for some time, then spreading across America without touching the ground, before God diffused it away from America and sent it out to the nations.
mentions.quote: hung there for quite some time and then spread out across America
mentions.falsify_match: An airborne threat over the eastern United States dispersed without landfall.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The thing itself is not named in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says most were unprepared and did not preach on it or treat it as a sign of something hundreds of thousands of times bigger, referring back to the planes striking the twin towers.
mentions.quote: the sign of something that is coming hundreds of thousands of times bigger
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on America of a scale far beyond September 11.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Hundreds of thousands of times bigger than 9/11 would mean casualties beyond the world population, so the figure is rhetorical rather than a measure.

mentions.claim_text: A news item is read out that Britain has supplied Ukraine with another shipment of Storm Shadow missiles, equipping Kyiv for long range strikes into Russia this winter.
mentions.quote: Britain has supplied Ukraine with another shipment of storm shadow missiles
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: a news report read aloud.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not his claim.

mentions.claim_text: He describes men in flapped hats covering their ears, running with AR-15 style rifles toward something, with snow on the ground.
mentions.quote: they were running with guns and it was snow on the ground
mentions.falsify_match: Winter fighting matching the description, which places it seasonally.
mentions.falsify_miss: None identifiable. The snow is the only timing marker and it points at any northern winter.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the spinning figure going around Europe coming to a standstill and looking, knowing something was different, and says all the devils in hell know.
mentions.quote: he came at a standstill and started looking
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: activity in the spirit realm with no observable signature.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He asks for a clip from the channel to be played, saying he feels the Holy Ghost strongly, and the clip begins with someone describing seeing something they had never seen.
mentions.quote: Then I saw with my eyes something I had never seen
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: a clip played on air.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not his claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a great shaking to awaken coming and that they must pray over New York, which he sees highlighted before him.
mentions.quote: we got to pray over New York. I see New York is highlighted
mentions.falsify_match: A major event in New York.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Highlighted carries no content.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the power grid going down again, buildings lit from outside by generators and spotlights, and complete darkness in parts of New York from a grid failure.
mentions.quote: I saw complete darkness in parts of New York
mentions.falsify_match: A major power failure across parts of New York City.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named city and a named failure mode, which is checkable against utility records.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees people leaving New York in droves, a mass migration.
mentions.quote: I see people leaving New York by the groves. A mass migration
mentions.falsify_match: Net outmigration from New York City at a scale visible in census data.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such outflow. New York City had already been losing population since 2020, which lowers the bar.

mentions.claim_text: He hears a family saying it is not safe here any more and they must go, a woman speaking to her husband, with children and a nice home on a street.
mentions.quote: It is not safe here anymore. We must go
mentions.falsify_match: Families leaving New York for safety reasons.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A scene inside the vision rather than an event, and no threshold is given.
